##### Project general facts

Tavora Residences is a contemporary residential development inspired by the refined elegance of European design combined with the warm, earthy tones of the desert landscape. The project offers a calm and well-connected urban lifestyle within an emerging residential community. With its clean architectural lines and thoughtfully designed façade, Tavora creates a sense of understated sophistication focused on comfort, serenity, and long-term livability.

The development features a carefully planned collection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, designed with efficiency and functionality in mind. Interiors include open kitchens, high ceilings, and full-height windows that maximize natural light and enhance the feeling of space. Minimalist layouts, premium materials, and modern finishes come together to create homes that are both practical and visually refined, suitable for professionals, couples, and small families.

Residents benefit from a range of lifestyle amenities designed to support wellness and community living. The project includes a swimming pool with sun deck, fully equipped gym, yoga studio, BBQ areas, and landscaped outdoor seating spaces that encourage relaxation and social interaction. Combined with strong connectivity and a convenient location, Tavora offers a balanced lifestyle that blends comfort, accessibility, and modern urban living. The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials. The kitchens are fully fitted and equipped, while the apartments are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

International City Phase 2 in Dubai is an extension of the original International City, designed to offer a modern residential community with a focus on affordability and convenience. Located in the Al Warsan area, this phase continues the theme of diverse, globally inspired architecture, offering a variety of residential apartments within low-rise buildings. With improved infrastructure and amenities, International City Phase 2 appeals to young professionals, families, and expatriates seeking cost-effective housing with good connectivity to major areas of Dubai.

The community features a blend of residential and commercial spaces, with essential services such as supermarkets, retail outlets, and dining options within close proximity. International City Phase 2 is also known for its accessibility, with easy access to major highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Dubai-Al Ain Road, making it well-connected to other parts of the city.

One of the highlights of International City Phase 2 is its focus on creating a balanced lifestyle, offering green spaces and parks for residents to enjoy. While being a budget-friendly alternative to some of Dubai's more upscale neighborhoods, the development maintains a community-centric design, with recreational facilities and open areas that promote a healthy and active lifestyle. This makes it an ideal choice for those seeking an affordable, yet well-equipped, community in Dubai.
